Needs changes before merge.

The new column height check keeps the stock checks active. The PR changes no golden files, UI files, dependencies, or build scripts.

I ran the review locally after a clean trial merge with upstream/main at `feabe2524946f71f5b8287c8a2f9a8d54a89f3c5`.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --no-run -j 6` | Passed |
| Motion library | 414 passed, 6 ignored |
| `bore_carried_ramp` | 2 failed |
| `contour_inside_ramp` | 2 passed |
| `entry_approach` | 9 passed |
| `entry_ramp_angle` | 5 passed |
| `one_descent` | 4 passed |
| App `carried_stock_entry` | 5 passed |
| Motion clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |

The quick gate failed only in `bore_carried_ramp`.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/motion/tests/bore_carried_ramp.rs:86` and `:110`: update both fixtures for the stock top parameter on current main. They set `material_top`, but do not set `stock_top`. Current main uses `stock_top` to include the Top Z level. Thus both new tests fail after the clean merge. Set `links.approach.stock_top` to the same carried stock height in both fixtures. Keep the existing assertions. Also remove the `known` exception for this case in `crates/motion/tests/one_descent.rs:277`, now present on main, as issue #2301 requires. Run the affected suites again.

Actual failures on the unmodified trial merge:

```text
planar: first level Some(-2.0), not Top Z 0
retract: first level Some(-2.0), not Top Z 0

assertion `left == right` failed: plunge starts
  left: [7.0, -2.0]
 right: [7.0, 0.0, -2.0]
```

Safety checks: I used a disposable source copy of the trial merge. I added only the two missing `stock_top` values to its fixtures. Both new tests then passed. I ran these mutations separately:

- Use `prev_z` for an unopened column: the stock test failed with `RapidInStock { at: 2673 }` for both level links.
- Ignore the earlier plunge in `column_top`: the later-level test failed with `[7.0, 7.0, 7.0]`, instead of `[7.0, 0.0, -2.0]`.

After I restored the production source in that copy, both tests passed again. I did not change the PR source or push a commit. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Back to draft. Reason: review fix. The fix sets `links.approach.stock_top` in the two bore fixtures. It also merges current main.

Review fix pushed. Head: 9c48efc2bddf325f626407e193aea786eaffcfbd.

Changes:
- Merged `origin/main` (clean, no conflict).
- `bore_carried_ramp.rs`: both fixtures now set `links.approach.stock_top` to the carried stock height. The assertions are unchanged.
- `one_descent.rs`: removed the `known` exception. The test passes without it.

Tests (debug, `-j 4`), all pass:
- `bore_carried_ramp`: 2
- `one_descent`: 4
- `contour_inside_ramp`: 2
- `entry_approach`: 9
- `entry_ramp_angle`: 5
- motion lib: 414 passed, 6 ignored
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

Not run: other crates, the batch tier, release lanes. The PR stays a draft.

Addressed: NeoTech already fixed both findings at head `9c48efc2bddf325f626407e193aea786eaffcfbd` while my verification was running. I stopped before pushing a duplicate change.

- Both `bore_carried_ramp` fixtures now set `stock_top` to the carried height. Existing assertions stay intact. Removing these values failed both tests; restoring them passed.
- `one_descent::the_bore_contour_under_carried_stock_never_rapids_into_it` now checks the formerly exempted cases. Mutating the unopened-column height failed with `RapidInStock`; restoring it passed. Ignoring an earlier plunge also failed the later-level bore pin; restoring it passed.

My worktree passed `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` against `feabe2524946f71f5b8287c8a2f9a8d54a89f3c5`: eight steps, zero failures. Motion library: 414 passed, 6 ignored. Affected motion suites: 22 passed. App carried-stock suite: 5 passed. Motion clippy with all targets and warnings denied passed.

The current head has identical motion production code and relevant test logic. My only remaining motion difference is a stale-comment cleanup. The current head also includes newer main changes to app posting; I did not rerun the gate on that head. No verification evidence was committed. Please re-review the current head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9c48efc2bddf325f626407e193aea786eaffcfbd -->
<!-- review-cost: effort:high · escalated: no -->
**Verdict: clean. No blockers. Label set: merge-ready.**
Delta review of head 9c48efc2b. Commits after 4be92dcdf: one merge of main (3fd151918; parents 4be92dcdf and d3e779907; `git show --remerge-diff` is empty - class SAME) and the two fix edits. Both earlier findings are closed.
- Fixture finding: `crates/motion/tests/bore_carried_ramp.rs:87` sets `links.approach.stock_top = Some(CARRIED);` and `:112` sets `Some(5.0)`. The carried-stock cases now pin what they exercise.
- Exception finding: `crates/motion/tests/one_descent.rs:294` now reads `if !w.is_empty() {`. The `known` exception is gone; every verify warning fails the test.
Gate (local build of this head): bore_carried_ramp 2 pass, one_descent 4 pass, camcraft-motion lib 414 pass / 6 ignored, clippy `-D warnings` clean.
Note (not a blocker): `crates/motion/tests/one_descent.rs:256` doc comment still says one case is excepted. The code no longer excepts it. A later commit may update the comment.
